verdict.rationale: YYLO captures task intent and a contract (a YAML-saveable task contract, Git-native Ledger records with status, `yy ledger ready`). It runs a read-only preflight, and agents only modify an isolated worktree after `task start`. These give a lead staging points to review scope before work begins. However, the evidence never documents an explicit human approval gate or sign-off on scope that blocks agent modification until granted. missing for 10: a documented approval/sign-off step for task scope and contract, enforcement that agents cannot start or modify the repo without that approval, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
